every_position_composed.reason: In the second site, frames 4 and 7 clear the UI card to give unobstructed, centered views of the 3D machinery during transitions, whereas the first site's text panel overlaps the top-left of the 3D rack in frames 4 and 5.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9, pressing raw log slabs into digests (frame 5), storing anchors (frame 6), and routing across seven host gates (frame 8).

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D models, bevels, materials, lighting, and floor grid shadows across all frames from 1 to 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography and card design are identical in frames 1-3, 5-6, and 8-9, the second site paces its layout better by hiding text cards in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D scene has room to breathe without overlap.

overall.reason: Built from the same core assets and copy, the second site wins by pacing its scroll transitions so that frames 4 and 7 present clean, unobstructed 3D compositions rather than letting the UI card overlap the machinery.
